significance: A Krishna temple at Thalappalam near Erattupetta in Kottayam district, where Radha-Krishna and Parvati-Parameswara are venerated as paired deities. Long held by the Kochupurakkal Nair family, it later passed to the NSS Karayogam of Thalappalam.
story: Villagers tell of farmers whose iron tools struck something buried in the fields, revealing a divine presence, and the shrine was raised there in a season of famine and epidemic.
